name: 71202 · Monroe, LA
findings: ZIP 71202 (Monroe) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71202 (Monroe) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 71202 (Monroe) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
